project.name: flamehaven-verification-ledger
project.canonical_statement: Master verification ledger orchestrating and archiving high-stakes mathematical and physical equation reproductions (Equation-to-Artifact/EQA), biomolecular AI validation reviews, and static bioscience compliance audits (Bioscience Compliance).

design_invariants.label: mpmath-precision-lock
design_invariants.statement: Standard float64 is strictly banned for Equation (2.2) and similar high-stakes EQA evaluations. Must use arbitrary-precision libraries (e.g., mpmath at >= 200-bit) to prevent catastrophic underflow cancellation.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-052: Standard double-precision floats underflowed to absolute zero in multi-quadratic class field calculations.

design_invariants.label: unmodified-run-provenance
design_invariants.statement: Verification run JSON data and file lists (e.g., analysis_result.json) must remain completely unedited to preserve audit integrity and scientific reproducibility.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-053: Discovered during EQA conversion that editing local execution outputs invalidates public verification signatures.

design_invariants.label: multimodel-structure-consensus
design_invariants.statement: Biomolecular AI structural checks must employ multi-model consensus validation (Trinity Core: AF3, AF2, Boltz-2, Chai-1) before promoting any biomedical model candidates.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-041: Single-model structural check failed to identify folding anomalies, causing downstream degradation in binding affinity predictions.

design_invariants.label: logos-reasoning-alignment
design_invariants.statement: Biomolecular AI logic checks must utilize explicit HTTP client sidecar routes to prevent namespace conflicts and import-latency drifts during FastAPI app execution.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-053: Standalone reasoning package import-time latency degraded request-path performance.

design_invariants.label: clinical-boundary-mapping
design_invariants.statement: Bioscience Compliance audits must explicitly map model capabilities and code surfaces against the MIT AI Risk Repository (AIRI) to isolate high-risk biological surfaces.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-034: Ambiguity in bioclaw classification permitted unchecked deployment of synthetic biological sequence generators.

design_invariants.label: isolated-scan-verification
design_invariants.statement: All Bioscience Compliance scan reports must be compiled as deterministic standalone HTML/MD files served with the standard Verification Ledger header.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-035: Inconsistent template headers in early reports weakened brand continuity for external auditors.

design_invariants.label: unified-visual-sdk-tokens
design_invariants.statement: Any new visualization, comparative data sandbox, 3D structure scene, or telemetry parsing pane added to the ledger must strictly utilize the visual tokens (HSL color system), comparative steering split-panels, or Three.js/Plotly configurations defined in the Flamehaven Verification UI/UX SDK.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-056: Standardized the EQA precision steer layout, BIV rotating WebGL helix lattice, and BRC compliance steer sandbox using a unified, reusable UI/UX Toolkit SDK.

design_invariants.label: global-window-bindings
design_invariants.statement: Any interactive JS handler or UI toggle function called inline from the HTML structure must be explicitly bound to the global window object in js/portal.js to ensure scoping compatibility and bypass browser module restrictions.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-058: Added explicit window exports at the end of portal.js to prevent browser module inline click resolution failures.

design_invariants.label: html-tag-balancing-protection
design_invariants.statement: Containers representing individual ledger dashboard sections (such as EQA, BAV, BSC, extras) must maintain strict, correct HTML tag balancing to prevent browser parser corruption from hiding downstream sections.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-059: Diagnosed that an unclosed BAV dashboard tag nested the BSC dashboard within a hidden element, and resolved it by restoring the missing closing div.

design_invariants.label: gate-rejection-spar-threshold
design_invariants.statement: An EQA run must achieve SPAR >= 80 and SIDRCE Omega >= 0.75 to pass the governance gate. Runs scoring below either threshold receive Gate REJECTED status and require documented revision before re-promotion. Omega in [0.75, 0.85) is AMBER; Omega < 0.75 is RED.

binding.origin_episode: TOE-TEST-0052: GTE pedagogy hypothesis scored SPAR 73/100 and SIDRCE Omega 0.697 (RED), resulting in Gate REJECTED. SPAR verdict: MINOR REVISION.

design_invariants.label: optional-layer-classification
design_invariants.statement: An EQA experiment that demonstrates exploratory value without satisfying core promotion criteria must be classified as OPTIONAL BACKEND REPRESENTATION LAYER: DO NOT PROMOTE TO CORE, KEEP ALIVE. This classification preserves the experiment in the ledger without granting core lane status, and is the correct disposition for AEFSO-pattern multi-phase experiments.

binding.origin_episode: TOE-TEST-0056/AEFSO: 7-phase experiment converged on AEFSO_INSIGHT_CONVERGES_TO_TOE_UPDATE but did not meet core promotion threshold. SPAR verdict: ACCEPT WITH BOUNDS. Classified optional_backend_representation_layer, not promoted.

design_invariants.label: degraded-sidecar-isolation
design_invariants.statement: When an EQA sidecar run receives DEGRADED SIDECAR verdict, the affected namespace must be immediately flagged for isolation. Dependent pipelines must not consume its outputs until namespace integrity is restored and a follow-up scan is filed.

binding.origin_episode: TOE-TEST-0053: Namespace integrity scan returned DEGRADED SIDECAR status; dependent pipeline consumption was blocked pending isolation and re-verification.

design_invariants.label: fixed-position-overflow-bypass
design_invariants.statement: Sidebar tooltip elements must use position:fixed (appended to document.body) rather than position:absolute. CSS-only hover tooltips are clipped by the sidebar's overflow:hidden/auto scroll context and will not render. JS must inject the tooltip div into body and compute coordinates via clientX/clientY.

binding.origin_episode: EXP-060: Folder description tooltips were invisibly clipped by overflow-x:hidden on .sidebar. Resolved by migrating to a JS position:fixed engine reading .sb-tooltip span innerHTML.

operation_meta.bootstrap_note: Master Verification Ledger MICA Package initialized at repository root to govern EQA, Biomolecular AI Validation, and Bioscience Compliance lanes.
